title: TENVY SCRIPT Auto Collect Eggs Deposit etc
features:
Chicken Farm Script

- Auto Collect Eggs — grabs every egg and clears them for lag-free farming
- Auto Deposit Eggs — banks held eggs automatically
- Auto Collect Cash — pulls in accumulated cash
- Auto Buy Processing — upgrades your egg-processing level when affordable
- Auto Buy Chickens — bulk-buys with x1 / x5 / x25 / x100 selector
- Auto Merge Chickens — merges 3→1 up the tier ladder automatically
- Auto Collect Lucky — grabs dropped lucky blocks (rarity-filtered grid)
- Auto Unlock Lucky — opens equipped lucky blocks and claims the chicken
